dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Consistent and linear narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins exhibit a smooth and symmetrical curve with no visible structural bulges or indentations; margins are slightly occluded by surface turbulence.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey pixel clusters distributed primarily along the central longitudinal axis.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradual and diffuse gradient transition between the darker axial regions and the lighter lateral margins.
